items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I didn't get a chance to see him when he went with Ori, I think. I didn't see him anymore.

ctx.x: Mutt, Mutt Carey. I remember him playing second trumpet occasionally with Chris at the Bull. And I didn't get a chance to see him when he went with Ori, I think. I didn't see him anymore.
That was a long time ago. Oh yeah. How long were you leading the Eureka?
